appName: PatchWorld — Make music together in VR

descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# Make music together in VR

PatchWorld is a multiplayer audiovisual playground where you can play instruments, jam with friends, patch sounds and visuals in 3D, and create musical worlds inside VR.

Jump into ready-made jam rooms, explore community creations, attend live events, or invent something entirely new.

**For curious and creative minds of all kinds:** beginners, musicians, producers, visual artists, performers, educators, and explorers.


[media]

# Hang out, jam & explore

Play and create with others in real time. Explore worlds made by the community. Attend live events, workshops, and performances. Share your creations and remix what others have built.


[media]


# Customize everything 

Import custom VRM avatars, design reactive costumes, and even create your own movement systems.

[media]


# Build your own systems — no coding needed

Use blocks to create:

- Musical instruments, synths, sequencers, and full music studios

[media]

- Interactive worlds, games, and playful systems

[media]

- Physics experiments and motion-based interactions


[media]

- VJ tools and real-time audiovisual effects

[media]


# Import or generate assets

Use the web portal at patchxr.com to bring your own sounds, images, 3D objects, or generate new assets inside PatchWorld with AI tools.

[media]

# Connect your setup

Go further with recording tools, spatial audio, MIDI, OSC, Ableton Link, and connections to your real-world setup.

[media]

Join our Discord for community support, and learn through our Wiki and workshops.
